purpose: Map user scenarios to concrete test assertions. This file states coverage, not the result of a test run.

levels.NORMAL: The expected user path with valid input and working test services.
levels.EDGE: Wrong input, missing rights, conflict, failure, or a less common valid result.
levels.EXTREME: A bounded stress case, concurrent work, restart, slow work, cancellation, or retry.

scopeNotes: Local hosts use temporary PostgreSQL and test models unless a scenario says otherwise.
A source-layer host restart is different from a built process crash.
Protocol tests may run a real HTTPS listener or a complete in-process HTTP handler. Each scenario states its boundary.
Empty coverage lists mean that this map makes no claim at that level.
Private engine, store, adapter, schema, and pure tests stay in their source packages.

PostgresTest requires initdb and pg_ctl from devenv, temporary file access, and free local ports. No skip or external-service credential gate is present in this file.
The delete cases use deferred values to hold backend opening or cleanup. They exercise real HTTP and socket work around that controlled backend state.
